text: No thermal anomalies or fires were detected by satellite sensors (MODIS or VIIRS) on the rural property between October 5, 2026, and November 3, 2026. However, the evidence is inconclusive for November 4, 2026, due to a data gap—satellite data for that day was either unavailable or not yet processed. Therefore, while no fires were detected during the majority of the period, we cannot definitively confirm the property was entirely fire-free for the full duration. Smaller or cooler fires may also have gone undetected.
